title: vecreg
description: Vector Affine/NonLinear Transformation with Orientation Preservation

input_file.description: Filename for input vector or tensor field
input_file.title: Input File

output_file.description: Filename for output registered vector or tensor field
output_file.title: Output File

secondary_affine.description: Filename for secondary affine matrix; if set, this will be used for the rotation of the vector/tensor field
secondary_affine.title: Secondary Affine Matrix File

secondary_warp.description: Filename for secondary warp field; if set, this will be used for the rotation of the vector/tensor field
secondary_warp.title: Secondary Warp Field

interp_method.description: Interpolation method (nearestneighbour, trilinear (default), sinc, or spline)
interp_method.title: Interpolation Method

ref_brain_mask.description: Brain mask in output space (useful for speed up of nonlinear registration)
ref_brain_mask.title: Reference Brain Mask
